EMBEDDED SOFTWARE ENGINEER, GROUND SYSTEMS




THE COMPANY

AnySignal is developing the next generation of RF products and services for some of the most demanding space and defense missions. We’re building a flexible, high-performance platform that’s easy to deploy, monitor, and scale, enabling customers to bring advanced radio technologies to life faster than ever before.




THE ROLE

We’re hiring an Embedded Software Engineer to develop the software that controls and operates our ground antenna systems.

This role sits at the intersection of software and electromechanical systems. You will develop software that controls antenna motion, motors, actuators, sensors, and other components, integrate new electrical and mechanical systems into the ground software stack, and work closely with mechanical, electrical, RF, and software engineers to build and operate reliable ground systems.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Develop software that supports the operation and integration of ground antenna systems

 - Develop reliable, low-level software for controlling motors, actuators, sensors, and other electromechanical components

 - Build and maintain interfaces between software and ground-station systems using low-level communication protocols

 - Integrate and test new electrical and mechanical systems with the antenna software stack

 - Troubleshoot software and electromechanical behavior across integrated systems

 - Develop automated tests and tools to validate antenna control software and system performance

 - Work closely with mechanical, electrical, RF, and software engineers to bring new ground-station capabilities into operation

 - Support the deployment and reliable operation of ground antenna systems in the field
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must-Haves:

 - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field

 - Strong software development experience in Python

 - Strong experience developing software in Embedded Linux environments

 - Experience with networking and software communication protocols

 - Professional experience developing and debugging software that integrates with motors, actuators, servos, encoders, sensors, controllers, or other electromechanical systems

 - Experience developing and debugging low-level interfaces and communication protocols

 - Experience with test automation and software validation

 - Ability to work cross-functionally with software, electrical, mechanical, and RF engineers
   
   

Preferred Qualifications:

 - Experience developing software in C or C++

 - Experience with RF systems, satellite communications, or ground-station systems

 - Experience deploying or supporting integrated software/electromechanical systems in field environments

 - Experience with GNU Radio or similar software-defined radio frameworks


COMPENSATION

The estimated base salary range for this role is $130,000-$200,000 per year, plus equity. This range reflects our good-faith estimate for this position at the time of posting. The final base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the candidate's qualifications, relevant experience, skills, and market considerations.

In addition to base salary and equity, AnySignal offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) program, competitive paid time off, and paid parental leave.




EXPORT CONTROL REQUIREMENTS

To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including ITAR, applicants must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the necessary authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

AnySignal is committed to building an inclusive and accessible workplace where all employees feel respected, supported, and able to contribute fully. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, including women, veterans, individuals with disabilities, and members of underrepresented communities.

If you require accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please contact us in confidence at careers@anysignal.com. We are committed to ensuring equal access for all applicants.
